project_task_description: Flask and SQLAlchemy REST backend for a coding classroom site: user accounts and roles, sections, posts and feedback, file uploads, data export, and calls to the GitHub, Gemini and Groq APIs
allowed_scopes: NETWORK_CONNECT:GitHub, Gemini and Groq APIs, the code_runner service, the MySQL database and the S3 user-uploads bucket
FILE_READ:instance/ (uploads, data, SQLite database), datasets/, templates/ and static/
FILE_WRITE:instance/ (uploads, data, SQLite database) and temporary code-runner files
PROCESS_EXEC:python3 and node code-runner subprocesses in api/python_exec_api.py and api/javascript_exec_api.py
SECRET_READ:application secrets from environment variables and .env (SECRET_KEY, database and API credentials)
